Strong knowledge of fresh produce, seasonality, quality standards and pricing fluctuations.

Understanding of pricing margins, freight costs, promotional planning and wastage risk.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Strong planning, reporting, research and organizational skills.

Ability to travel regularly across metropolitan and regional locations.

Ability to make commercially sound purchasing decisions.
